clue.text: Using a needle, cause irritation in wound

explanation.surface: Sewing with a needle chafes a sore wound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is the container signal; 'wound' looks like part of the sewing scene but supplies the outer word.
explanation.definitionFit: Sewing is done with a needle and thread, making joins one loop at a time.

clue.text: The newly-designed dais is not so called

explanation.definitionFit: The French loan phrase means self-styled or purported, describing something by a name it may not deserve.

clue.text: Broadcast for children

clue.text: The language of a music man!

clue.text: Part of a sentence where the head holds up drink

clue.text: It's an advantage being determined

clue.text: Time is pressing

clue.text: One trade setting a really high standard

clue.text: A man's make-up is of absorbing interest to him

clue.text: Controversial low furniture

definitions.text: A hard case in the main

clue.text: Deliver plaster
